  <strong>2026-11-16</strong> – <a href="https://github.com/insin/control-panel-for-twitter">control-panel-for-twitter</a> <a href="https://github.com/insin/control-panel-for-twitter/releases/tag/v4.99.1">v4.99.1</a>
  <div><em>Browser extension which gives you more control over your Twitter timeline and adds missing features and UI improvements - for desktop and mobile</em></div>
  <details><summary>v4.99.1 release notes</summary><p>Visit the <a href="https://soitis.dev/control-panel-for-twitter" rel="nofollow">Control Panel for Twitter website</a> for installation links, more information about the extension, and FAQs (mostly about why Safari is so weird about extensions).</p>
<p>Follow <a href="https://twitter.com/ControlPanelFT" rel="nofollow">@ControlPanelFT</a> on Twitter or <a href="https://bsky.app/profile/soitis.dev" rel="nofollow">@soitis.dev</a> on Bluesky for updates.</p>
<h2>Changes</h2>
<h3>Old UI</h3>
<ul>
<li>Fixed user Chat messages missing their background colour</li>
<li>Fixed the Dim theme missing some borders</li>
<li>Fixed some Subscribe buttons not being hidden</li>
<li>Fixed startup logo replacement when Restore Twitter branding is off</li>
<li>Fixed Settings → Privacy and safety → Chat not being themed</li>
</ul>
<h3>New UI</h3>
<ul>
<li>Added a font size option, as X haven't added one to the new UI (yet?)</li>
<li>Fixed live-updating of the Notifications timeline causing items which should be hidden to reappear</li>
</ul>
